deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1, 2026; the final deadline is December 15, 2026.
deadline.quote: Our priority deadline is December 1, 2026. The FINAL application deadline is December 15, 2026, after which point no applications will be accepted.

fee_waiver.value: The chemistry department gives no discretionary fee waivers, and international applicants can only get a discretionary department waiver, so an Indian applicant should expect to pay.
fee_waiver.quote: The Chemistry Department does not offer discretionary application fee waivers.

also.quote: International students are only eligible to receive a discretionary fee waiver from their department of interest.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; scores are considered only if provided.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for admission into the program.

also.quote: GRE: The General GRE is not required but is encouraged.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 minimum, alongside TOEFL 89 and Duolingo 130.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System, minimum score 7.0

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed before applying; students do three lab rotations in their first semester.
supervisor.quote: At Vanderbilt, we do not admit students for specific labs. Rather, our admitted students complete three lab rotations in their first semester to find their research lab.

funding.value: Five years of funding (tuition, health insurance, stipend of $36,500) is guaranteed to all full-time students in good standing.
funding.quote: The graduate program in chemistry provides year-round financial support, guaranteed for five full years to all full-time graduate students in good standing.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree (or coursework) in chemistry or a related field; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have worked, or be currently working, towards an undergraduate degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or chemical biology

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

notes: Priority deadline Dec 1; final Dec 15. Departmental flyer for international applicants lists TOEFL 89, IELTS 7, Duolingo 130.
